name: SM_Gravestone_Broken_PR
dresses: headstone snapped across on a slant, its head lying face down on the grave, and a skull worked up out of the mound beside it; weather-rounded edges, moss from the foot and on the north face, lichen; a turfed grave mound in front (the stone runs 0.35 m into the ground)

fit.pivot: ground at the foot of the stone; face to -Y, the grave lies toward -Y

material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: As the round stone; the fallen head does not match the break line of the stump; the skull beside it is the simple SM_Skull_PR. 4 material slots (limit 3).
